page-structure.evidence: Heading order is severely broken: five <h4> elements appear before the only <h1> ('Save more time with Southern Airways'); the heading sequence then jumps h1→h4→h5→h6 throughout the page. The page title 'Book Flights - Southern Airways Express' is descriptive (2.4.2 NOT REPRODUCED). Landmarks present: banner, nav, main, contentinfo. No landmark-level defect. The broken heading hierarchy (h4 before h1, h1→h4→h5→h6 skips) violates 1.3.1 (structure) and 2.4.6 (headings and labels). Missing h1 as first heading is best-practice (axe page-has-heading-one). 10 lists use list-style:none without role='list' — VoiceOver list-stripping risk (1.3.1, WebKit-specific).

grouping-and-reading-order.evidence: 10 <ul>/<ol> elements have computed list-style-type:none with no role='list', making them invisible as lists in Safari/VoiceOver (1.3.1). The #myTab tablist wraps role=tab anchors inside <li> elements that have no role=tab themselves; the <li> children have role=null, making them role=listitem inside a tablist — violating aria-required-children (4.1.2 / 1.3.1). Tab walk shows 26 off-screen stops (carousel/slider items) appearing in focus order while visually hidden, suggesting DOM order diverges from visible order.

reflow.evidence: At 320px viewport: scrollWidth=389, clientWidth=320, ratio=1.22. General layout elements overflow (DIV.hfeed site, HEADER.site-header, MAIN.site-main, ARTICLE, DIV.entry-content) — not exempt data-table or map content. Horizontal scrolling required.
